run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot GPTQ quantization on a multimodal vision model with W4A16 scheme
create_gptq_recipe: create a GPTQModifier recipe targeting Linear layers while ignoring lm_head and vision tower modules
test_quantized_model_generation: test a quantized multimodal model by generating text descriptions from input images
build_quantized_model_offload: build model offloading with dispatch_model for a quantized Gemma3 vision-language model
save_quantized_model_compressed: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed format
